title: Toward Socially Aware Vision-Language Models: Evaluating Cultural Competence Through Multimodal Story Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Perturbing nationality cues in textual prompts for multimodal story generation and evaluating model outputs using Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions, World Values Survey data, lexical diversity metrics (TF-IDF, BLEU), cross-modal semantic similarity, and human evaluation of cultural authenticity, cultural nuance, and stereotype avoidance.

Using counterfactual nationality substitution in prompts (covering 42 countries) to measure cross-cultural variations in generated children's stories and assessing lexical variance within and across different nationalities using ANOVA.

Analyzing the linguistic origins of highly correlated words (e.g., personal names) generated by the models to identify the overrepresentation of majority ethnic groups (e.g., Hindi/Sanskrit names in India, Yoruba/Igbo names in Nigeria) and the marginalization of minority linguistic communities.
